character_sheet: A rabbit: a body and an upper body, a head with a nose and two long ears, two front paws, two legs with feet and a tail (ModelEasterBunny.java:37-49; 13 parts on a 64x128 sheet). It is a skittish holiday animal: 10 HP, speed 0.45, an unused 8-damage attribute (EasterBunny.java:59-64) - no goal strikes. It floats (:49), breeds on crystal apples (:50, :93-96), runs from monsters AND players (:51-52), panics when hurt (:53), watches other mobs (:54) and strolls avoiding water (:55); about once in 600 ticks it lays a stack of one to three random spawn eggs from a 115-slot table (:104-237). It spawns only at Easter, above y 50, by day, never within 32 blocks of another (:245-256); a kit is drawn at half size (EasterBunnyRenderer.java:39-41). Read it as a quick, nervous hare: a fast two-legged hop with the ears flapping at half the stride rate, the ears twitching gently when it stops.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig, x0.5 as a baby (EasterBunnyRenderer.java:27, 39-41) on a 64x128 sheet (ModelEasterBunny.java:108); the hitbox is 0.5 x 0.75 (ModEntities.java:371-373); shadow 0.5 (EasterBunnyRenderer.java:29).

labels.head: head
labels.rear: right ear (rest -0.418 rad; flaps the other way)
labels.lfoot: left foot (swings with the left leg)
labels.rfoot: right foot (swings with the right leg)

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) x the walking speed at 2.6 x 0.55 - still below the 0.1 threshold, no rest offsets
groups.plain: the two legs hop in opposition, each foot swinging with its leg
groups.math: a = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 2.6 * 0.55) * pi * 0.15 * limbSwingAmount : 0; lleg.xRot = lfoot.xRot = a; rleg.xRot = rfoot.xRot = -a
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.6 x 0.55 (wingspeed, ModelEasterBunny.java:21): the natural period is 2 pi / 1.43 = 4.4 ticks

groups.name: ears
groups.amplitude: rests -0.226 rad (left) and -0.418 (right), then on the move pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) x the walking speed, at a standstill pi x 0.01 = 0.031 rad (1.8 deg); the right ear takes the negative
groups.plain: the ears flap in opposition at half the stride rate on the move and twitch faintly at rest
groups.math: e = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.55) * pi * 0.1 * limbSwingAmount : cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.55) * pi * 0.01; lear.xRot = -0.226 + e; rear.xRot = -0.418 - e
groups.phase: the walking-speed threshold selects the amplitude (ModelEasterBunny.java:115, 118): the rate is the same in both branches
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.55: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.715 = 8.8 ticks - half the gait rate; the walking branch scales it by speed though it is not the gait group

behaviour: Two branches on the walking speed (ModelEasterBunny.java:115-121). On the move (above 0.1): the cosine of the age x 2.6 x 0.55 (wingspeed, :21), x pi x 0.15, x the walking speed swings the left leg and foot forward and the right pair back - 27 degrees at full speed every 4.4 ticks (:122-123); the ears take the cosine of the age x 1.3 x 0.55, x pi x 0.1, x the walking speed - 18 degrees every 8.8 ticks, half the stride rate - the left around -0.226 rad and the right, negated, around -0.418 (:124-125).
At a standstill the legs hold 0 and the ears keep the same rhythm at a tenth of the amplitude - a 1.8-degree twitch every 8.8 ticks (:120).

The body, upper body, head, nose, paws and tail never move; nothing reads the look (netHeadYaw unused), so the LookAtPlayerGoal (EasterBunny.java:54) turns nothing visible. There is no attacking flag and no strike; the egg laying (:110-111, :116-237) is a drop with no pose of its own.

formulas: `ModelEasterBunny.setupAnim` (ModelEasterBunny.java:112-126; orig ModelEasterBunny.java:120-129 in `render` (func_78088_a, :113-143; func_78087_a at :151-153 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.55 from `new ModelEasterBunny(0.55f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:498): while the walking speed is above a tenth the leg swing is the cosine of the age in ticks times 2.6 times 0.55, times pi, times 0.15, times the walking speed and the ear swing the cosine of the age times 1.3 times 0.55, times pi, times 0.1, times the walking speed; at or below it the leg swing is 0 and the ear swing is the cosine of the age times 1.3 times 0.55, times pi, times 0.01; the left foot and leg pitch by the leg swing, the right foot and leg by its negative, the left ear by -0.226 plus the ear swing and the right ear by -0.418 minus it. The walk position, the head angles and the entity's state play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (EasterBunnyGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
